_note: Registry of official sources per issuer. Steps are a cached fallback for demos; in production gov.retrieve refreshes them from source_url at time of use and records retrieved_at.

LHDN.name: Lembaga Hasil Dalam Negeri Malaysia
online_steps: Log in to the official MyTax portal (mytax.hasil.gov.my).
Open ByrHASIL and choose FPX or card payment.
Enter your income tax number, year of assessment and amount.
Save the receipt.
walkin_steps: Go to the nearest LHDN branch.
Check hours and appointment rules on hasil.gov.my first.
Ask the counter about instalments if needed.

lesson.a: Monthly tax deductions (PCB) are an estimate. When your yearly assessment shows more tax due than was deducted, LHDN sends a notice for the balance.

JPJ.name: Jabatan Pengangkutan Jalan Malaysia
online_steps: Open the official MyJPJ app or jpj.gov.my.
Check the summons with your vehicle number.
Pay the compound in the official app.
Keep the e-receipt.
walkin_steps: Go to the nearest JPJ office.
Check counter hours first.
Ask how to name the driver if it was not you.

lesson.a: Cameras record the plate, not the driver, so the notice goes to the registered owner, who pays or names the driver.

PTPTN.name: Perbadanan Tabung Pendidikan Tinggi Nasional
online_steps: Open the official myPTPTN app.
Check the arrears amount.
Pay by FPX or apply for restructuring / salary deduction.
Save the receipt.
walkin_steps: Go to the nearest PTPTN counter.
Check hours on ptptn.gov.my.
Ask about a restructured schedule.

lesson.a: Repayment starts after graduation. Missed monthly payments are flagged and a reminder is sent before stronger follow-up.

PDRM.name: Polis Diraja Malaysia
online_steps: Check summons yourself through the official PDRM channel / MyBayar PDRM.
Never use links or numbers given inside a suspicious message.
Report suspected scams to NSRC 997.
walkin_steps: Go to the nearest police station.
Bring the notice and your IC.

lesson.a: Real police notices name a specific offence and point to official channels. Messages that demand transfers or threaten instant arrest are scams.

COURT.name: Mahkamah (Court)
online_steps: Check the case on the official judiciary site.
Call the registry using the number on kehakiman.gov.my, not the letter.
walkin_steps: Attend the named court on the date given.
Bring the notice and IC.

lesson.a: Courts send notices to parties and witnesses. They ask you to attend or respond, not to pay strangers.

COUNCIL.name: Pihak Berkuasa Tempatan (Council)
online_steps: Pay on your council's official portal.
Save the receipt.
walkin_steps: Pay at the council counter.
Bring the bill.

lesson.a: Councils charge property assessment tax twice a year to fund local services.

UTILITY.name: Tenaga Nasional Berhad (TNB) / Suruhanjaya Tenaga
online_steps: Open the official myTNB app or mytnb.com.my yourself.
Check the arrears amount on your account.
Pay through the app or portal.
Save the receipt.
walkin_steps: Go to the nearest Kedai Tenaga TNB counter.
Bring the notice and pay the arrears.

lesson.a: Under the Electricity Supply Act 1990 (section 38), a licensee may cut supply if a bill stays unpaid after the notice period. Borang A is the formal warning before that.

KWSP_PERKESO.name: Kumpulan Wang Simpanan Pekerja (KWSP) / PERKESO
online_steps: Log in to i-Akaun on kwsp.gov.my or the official KWSP app yourself.
Check the arrears amount.
Pay through the official channel.
Save the receipt.
walkin_steps: Go to the nearest KWSP branch counter.
Bring the notice and IC.

lesson.a: Employers must pay EPF contributions by the 15th of each month (section 43, Act 452). Late payment adds a late-payment charge. KWSP never uses WhatsApp or Telegram agents and charges no commission.

BANK.name: Bank / Insurance
online_steps: Log in through the bank's official app you already use.
Never share TAC or passwords.
Call the number printed on your card if unsure.
walkin_steps: Visit your branch with IC.

lesson.a: Banks send statements, arrears and renewal notices. They never ask for your TAC or password.
